evidence.Commando/Select: p4: Select button - Use to select either 1 player or 2 player mode. When the game finishes, use to select CONTINUE or END.
evidence.Commando/Start: p4: Start button - Press to begin your mission. Press again after you've selected CONTINUE or END when the game finishes. Also press to PAUSE the action.
evidence.Commando/Left: p4: [Control Pad left] Move left | Shoot left | Jump left
evidence.Commando/Right: p4: [Control Pad right] Move right | Shoot right | Jump right
evidence.Commando/Down: p4: [Control Pad down] Laydown | Shoot either left or right | Climb down
evidence.Commando/B: p4: Using the Control Pad in sync with the A Button and B Button: column B Button - Shoot upward / Shoot right / Shoot left ...
evidence.Commando/A: p4: Using the Control Pad in sync with the A Button and B Button: column A Button - Jump upward / Jump right / Jump left ...
evidence.Commando/Up+B: p4: [Control Pad up] You won't move | Shoot upward | Jump upward
evidence.Commando/Up+A: p4: [Control Pad up] You won't move | Shoot upward | Jump upward
evidence.Commando/Down+B: p4: [Control Pad down] Laydown | Shoot either left or right | Climb down
evidence.Commando/Down+A: p4: [Control Pad down] Laydown | Shoot either left or right | Climb down
evidence.Commando in 3-D/Select: p4: Select button - Use to select either 1 player or 2 player mode. When the game finishes, use to select CONTINUE or END.
evidence.Commando in 3-D/Start: p4: Start button - Press to begin your mission. ... Also press to PAUSE the action.
evidence.Commando in 3-D/Left/Right: p4: Control Pad - Use to move forward, to the left or to the right. Press pad down to lay down.
evidence.Commando in 3-D/Down: p4: Control Pad - Use to move forward, to the left or to the right. Press pad down to lay down.
evidence.Commando in 3-D/B: p4: B Button - Press to fire.
evidence.Commando in 3-D/A: p4: A Button - Press to jump.
